title: Pesticide Application Checklist
subtitle: Pesticide Application: documents findings, limits, and disposition.
description: Pesticide Application Checklist covers site, target, product, application equipment, weather condition, buffer, and reentry control. The application record owner records Pesticide Application criteria, findings, restrictions, and follow-up. Pesticide Application Checklist keeps Pesticide Application exceptions visible until the application record owner handoff.
use_case: Use Pesticide Application Checklist at field, block, structure, treatment zone, mixing area, and buffer boundary. Document site, target, product, application equipment, weather condition, buffer, and reentry control identity before Pesticide Application begins. Compare site, target, product, application equipment, weather condition, buffer, and reentry control findings with stated Pesticide Application criteria; route unresolved Pesticide Application issues to licensed or otherwise qualified pesticide reviewer. For Pesticide Application Checklist, confirm requirements for Pesticide Application. Ask licensed or otherwise qualified pesticide reviewer to review Pesticide Application conditions beyond the application record owner's role.

sections.title: Inspector, location, and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Pesticide Application, identify responsible parties, field, block, structure, treatment zone, mixing area, and buffer boundary, and the linked site, target, product, application equipment, weather condition, buffer, and reentry control source.

sections.guidance: Use observed Pesticide Application evidence to state disposition. Keep limits visible and give Application Record Owner both correction and repeat-check responsibility.

blocks.guidance: Pause Pesticide Application when authorization, weather, drift, exposure, equipment integrity, or required restriction remains unresolved. Retain the available Pesticide Application proof and route unresolved site, target, product, application equipment, weather condition, buffer, and reentry control scope to application record owner.
